title: Practice 3: Someone who does or is something

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **зри́тель** — spectator, onlooker, viewer. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Зрители** — зри́тель: spectator, onlooker, viewer; audience. Wiktionary: зреть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: leader, chief, manager, director, instructor, teacher
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: изда́тель — publisher (one who publishes, especially books); мысли́тель — thinker; иссле́дователь — researcher; руководи́тель — leader, chief, manager, director, instructor, teacher.

**изда́тель** — publisher (one who publishes, especially books). Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: The publisher told me to make my book shorter.
exercises.why: **Издатель** — изда́тель: publisher (one who publishes, especially books). Wiktionary: изда́ть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **мысли́тель** — thinker. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Germany is known for being the country of poets and thinkers.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: кни́жник — (colloquial) bibliophile, book lover; америка́нец — male American (citizen, resident); глупец — fool, blockhead, turkey, gander, dummy, dunce, idiot; ста́рец — (bookish) old man, whitebeard.

**руководи́тель** — leader, chief, manager, director, instructor, teacher. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
